purpose: Check learned recorded-arrival demand with completed-feedback correction on a separately collected service trace
source_check: Git blob SHA1 and byte length from official contents API; local SHA256 retained; all timestamped rows counted
timestamp_policy: Use recorded wall-clock order only. Timezone is not specified in public description; no UTC, weekday or calendar features
train: Copilot June3-5 only, unchanged HGB q90 settings, delays1/2/6 and normalized peak targets
selection: Copilot June6 chooses equally corrected baseline; no external selection or tuning
feedback: Existing fixed positive q90 normalized raw residual; window288, minimum96, scale>=1call; same feedback for all baselines
external_feedback_delivery_assumption: Label complete at i+h+1 and immediately available; real delivery time absent
external_score_end: Last complete peak target of each source's single 24-hour trace
source_quality_gate: Complete timestamps in a single recorded calendar day; time bins within288; source integrity matches; score support gate before computing losses
gate: Each service/horizon loss>=5% lower than donor-validation-selected equally corrected baseline AND coverage85..95%; overall transfer requires all six conditions
prior_exposure: Existing donor/test and source descriptions previously inspected; new raw external traces and external model scores not yet inspected
scope: Published arrival counts at different observation layers; Copilot internal LLM calls differ from Azure service invocations; no GPU/VM sizing or scaling action effects
